data.narrative:
Deep Atomic is a pre-seed nuclear energy company founded by William G.J. Theron operating within a sector comprising 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 6 private peers including Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy.

Traditional peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to Deep Atomic due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the nuclear energy sector. Of the 5 nuclear energy peers identified, none meet the threshold of three or more datapoints when filtered by stage, adjacent stage, or valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial distortion given the heterogeneity in development timelines and capital intensity across nuclear subsegments. Consequently, no triangulated valuation range can be supported through comparable company analysis at this time.

The analysis highlights a structural limitation: Deep Atomic operates in a sparsely populated pre-seed cohort within nuclear energy, where early-stage funding rounds remain infrequent and poorly documented. Valuation determination would require alternative methodologies such as venture capital method analysis using company-specific projections, discounted cash flow modeling, or direct investor discussion of round terms. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to the identified private peer set, capital intensity of the development path, and regulatory/licensing timelines specific to Deep Atomic's technical approach. Any valuation conclusion must be deferred pending additional data on these company-specific dimensions.
